verdict.rationale: Substantive text excerpts were retrieved from several canada.ca CRA guidance pages (business registration, e-services, EFILE, the CRA home page), which suggests the public reading surface is fetchable as plain content. The llms.txt probe also got an ordinary HTTP 302 rather than a challenge page, so no bot wall was observed. However, no probe directly records a guidance-page fetch with an identified user agent, its HTTP status, or the absence of JS-only rendering or CAPTCHA, so reachability is inferred rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: a direct agent-UA probe of guidance pages returning 200 with server-rendered content, explicit confirmation of no bot-wall or CAPTCHA interstitial, and independent corroboration of keyless agent access.
